name: guardrails
description: Blocks edits outside the task spec, made-up packages, check-weakening edits and destructive git; gates finishing, committing and /ship on passing checks.

stopGate.title: Gate end of turn on checks
stopGate.description: After Claude edits code, checks must pass before it can finish (2 retries, then it stops and reports).

promptRule.title: Add the guardrails rule to the system prompt
promptRule.description: About 110 tokens per turn: terse, Suggestions section, verify before claiming, prefer existing libraries.

draftSpecs.title: Save long prompts as a spec draft
draftSpecs.description: A prompt over 1500 characters with no .claude/spec.md yet is saved there as a draft.

writingGate.title: Check commit and PR text for AI phrasing
writingGate.description: Blocks git commit, git tag and gh pr/issue text that uses em dashes or stock phrases (delve, seamless, leverage, robust...) until it is reworded.

researchHoldLines.title: Hold large new files until the library is looked up (lines)
researchHoldLines.description: A new source file at least this long that imports a library the session has not searched, read or fetched docs for is held once. 0 turns it off.

newTaskPercent.title: Hold new tasks above (% context)
newTaskPercent.description: A long new prompt above this context use is held once; sending it again goes ahead.

allowImports.title: Extra allowed imports
allowImports.description: Comma-separated package names the import check accepts without finding them installed.

checkTimeoutMinutes.title: Check timeout (minutes)
checkTimeoutMinutes.description: How long each check command may run.
